prose: Orchestrator, 2026-11-13: test_trim_keeps_the_newest_lines in bin/proofs/test_logger_for_bash.py reds on Windows with 'expected exactly 10 lines after trim, got 201'. Measured cause: Git Bash ships no flock(1), and bin/logger_for_bash logtrim runs `flock -x -w 5 9 || exit 0` inside a brace group with a 9> redirect, so a missing flock (127) or a timed-out one (1) skips the cut, and the exit 0 runs in the CALLER's shell, not a subshell.
